tei:titleStmt.tei:title: 437)༄༅/gu ru drag po'i rgyun gyi nyams len me rlung 'khyil pa bzhugs/he ru ka khros pa'i rgyal po pad+ma thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal lo/chos rgyal rata
437)༄༅/gu ru drag po'i rgyun gyi nyams len me rlung 'khyil pa bzhugs/he ru ka khros pa'i rgyal po pad+ma thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal lo/chos rgyal rata

tei:div.tei:p: 437) ༄༅/ gu ru drag po'i rgyun gyi nyams len me rlung 'khyil pa bzhugs/ he ru ka khros pa'i rgyal po pad+ma thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal lo/

chos rgyal rat+na gling pas mkhar chu dpal gyi phug ring nas spyan drangs pa'i drag sgrub thams cad kyi yang snying 'di nyid nyams su blang ba la sbyor dngos rjes so/ dang po gzhan phan gyi bsam pas kun nas bslangs te/ thog mar rgyud sbyang ba ni/ bla ma rig 'dzin rgyal ba zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal: sogs lan gsum brjod la/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ sa/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par bsam/ mchod rdzas dngos bshams yod na sngags tsam gyis byin gyis brlab/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi bskyed bzlas kyi rnal 'byor ni/ hūm̐: rang byung rig pa de bzhin nyid: rol rtsal kun snang snying rje'i gdangs: rgyu yi hūm̐ gis snod bcud sbyangs: 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab steng: 438)phyi rol rdo rje'i srung 'khor dang: drag po'i gzhal yas mtshan rdzogs dbus: bdud bzhi nyi zla pad+ma'i steng: hūm̐ dmar 'od kyi rang bzhin babs: spro bsdu sbyor ba'i khro rgyal sku: bdag nyid rig pa'i ngo bo las: 'jigs byed rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: dmar nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: g.yas dkar g.yon sngo dbus dmar zhal: g.yas gsum rdo rje gri gug gri: g.yon gsum bhan+dha kha ṭām̐ sdig: zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum 'dor thabs bgrad: rdo rje rin chen gshog pa gdengs: dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs par gsal: yum chen phag mo mthing nag 'khril: gri thod 'khyud stob brkyang bskum sbyor: 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad kyang: nyid dang 'od zer ji bzhin du: ma 'dres yongs rdzogs chen por bsgoms: spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: yul gyi ming ni rnga yab gling: 439) zangs mdog dpal ri'i gnas mchog gi: pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas: khrag 'thung khro bo rol pa yi: dmar nag me yi klong dkyil nas: gdug ba ma lus 'dul mdzad pa'i: rje btsun pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol:

gu ru badz+ra kro dha de wa ḍā ki ni sarba sa ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: a ti pu ho: pra ti dza ho: mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: drag po pad+ma'i lha tshogs la: mchod pa'i bye brag 'bul ba ni: phyi mchod 'dod yon rnam pa lnga: nang mchod sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: gsang mchod byang sems bde stong rgyun: thabs mchog mthar phyin bdud rtsi dang: shes rab mthar phyin rak+ta dang: thabs shes dbyer med gtor ma sogs: sku gsum klong du 440)bzhes nas kyang: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ gu ru badz+ra kro dha de wa ḍā ki ni sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ sogs/ shab+ta ma hā pañtsa rak+ta ba ling+taṃ khā hi: bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: rang byung lhun grub pad+ma 'byung gnas sku: dus gsum sangs rgyas sku gsung las sprul: mthu rtsal rmad byung pad+ma he ru ka: lha srin dregs pa 'dul ba'i sku mnga' ba: dbang drag pad+ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ bdag nyid rtsa ba'i thugs ka ru: rin chen 'bar ba'i dbus nyid du: gser gyi mchod rten ser po ni: ri rab bang rim bum pa bre: chos 'khor gdugs tog 'od zer 'bar: bum pa'i dbus su nyi zla'i steng: ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka ru: rdo rje rtse lnga'i lte ba la: nyi zla kha sbyor dbus su hūm̐: rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor bar bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐ a rtsig ne rtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: 441)a hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: zhes ci nus su 'bad/ mthar thun bsdu ba'i tshe/ rten dang brten pa'i snang cha kun: 'od gsal gdod ma'i gshis su thim: slar yang zung 'jug sgyu ma'i sku'i: gnas gsum rdo rje'i 'bru gsum mtshan: badz+ra rak+ṣa hūm̐: gsum pa ni/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag: he ru kaḥdapal 'grub gyur nas: ces sogs dang*/ byin rlabs mchog stsol rtsa brgyud bla ma dang: dngos grub char 'bebs yi dam zhi khro'i lha: phrin las thogs med dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs:

rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lo'i bkra shis shog: sogs bsngo smon bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan no// ces pa 'di ni rang gzhan la phan pa'i bsam pas btsun gzugs 'jam dpal grub pa'i blo gros kyis bris pa dge legs 'phel/ phyag bris dngos las zhal bshus pa'o// bkra shis// 442) 443)rang mdun pad nyi mi ro'i steng: bdag las rgyu yi hūm̐ spros te: lha chen mthing nag rab 'jigs pa: zhal gcig phyag gnyis ber nag gsol: hūm̐ mtshan bing dang zhags pa bsnams: thod skam lnga dang sbrul nag ral: sbrul nag mgo phreng snying gis spras: gser ka mi lpags bing chen gtsugs: spyan gsum khrag 'dra gyen mthur bsgrad: gyad kyi 'dor thabs tshul gyis bzhugs: g.yas su srog bdud rta nag zhon: kha ṭam̐ gri gug lcags par thogs: bdud mda' phyir bkang gling bzhir rgyug: g.yon du dpal 'bar sku mdog dmar: ral gri phyar zhing thod khrag stob: g.yang gzhi stag sham nyi zlas brgyan: phyi rol yang 'khor brgyad po ni: lha dang gshin rje 444)gnod sbyin klu: gza' dang ma mo bdud btsan sogs: 'khor gyi dmag tshogs khroms ltar bskyed: thugs srog hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas: rang bzhin gnas nas spyan drangs gyur: hūm̐: dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: tshur gshegs tshur gshegs mthu bo che: 'og min gnas mchog dam pa nas: gsang chen lhun grub gzhal yas nas: dur khrod thod mkhar brtsegs pa yi: bskal pa'i me rlung 'tshub dkyil nas: ma hā ka la gshegs su gsol: gter bdag chen po gshegs su gsol: ma ning nag po= bdud rgyal thod phreng= gnam lcags spu gri= tshogs bdag chen po= srog bdud nag po= yang 'khor sde brgyad= lha brgyad gshin rje gnod sbyin dang: klu brgyad 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: oṃ shri ma hā ka la sa ma ya dza hūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ 445)tiṣ+ṭha lhan: ā ti pu ho: pra ti dza ho: hūm̐: ma hā ka la thugs dam can: khyed la mchod pa 'bul ba ni: rin chen snod dam bhan dha ru:

bshos nag 'bar ba khrag gis byugs: tsit+ta snying gi rgyal mtshan btsugs: g.yag lug nag po khyi yi mtshan: dgra bo'i sha rus thod tshal spungs: rak+ta dmar gyi zham chu 'bab: dam rdzas gtor chen 'bar ba 'dis: dpal mgon nag po'i thugs dam bskang: gzhan yang thugs dam bskang ba ni: bdud rtsi sman gtor rak+ta dang: sha sna snying sna khrag sna dang: chibs rta 'gel g.yag rten lug dang: bing dang ru mtshon g.yang gi rdzas: mthun rdzas du mas thugs dam bskang: ma ning nag po 'khor bcas kyi: thugs dam gnyen po bskang gyur cig: oṃ shrī ma hā ka la gha na gu h+ya raṃ sid+dhi hūm̐ phaṭa: 446)badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs/ shab+ta pū tsa ho: pañtsa amṛ ta ma hā bha liṃ ta ma hā rak+ta kha hī: maṃ sa king ni ri ti go ro tsa na ba su ta tsit+ta khā hi khā hi: hūm̐: dpal chen he ru ka yi sku gsung thu+ugs las sprul: 'chol ba'i khro rgyal dpal mgon ma ning sku: dar nag ber gsol ru mtshon snying zhags bsnams: gter bdag chen po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: snying sbrul thod phreng 'bar ba'i rgyan gyis bklubs: tsan+dan bing btsugs srid pa'i lha dmag bzlog: yang 'khor sde brgyad dmag tshogs dpung dang bcas: bstan pa srung mdzad khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod: nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa yis: gsang chen bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang: bdag cag 'gal rkyen kun zhi mthun pa'i rkyen: ma tshang med 'byor bsam don lhun grub mdzod: chos rgyal rat+na gling pa'i 447) zab gter srung ma'i dbang po dpal mgon ma ning nag po dge ri ma'o// dpal chen 'dus pas so// 448) 449) ༄༅/ rat+na'i phur pa yang gsang bla med kyi spu gri kho na bzla bar 'dod pas/ gsang sgrub las byang chung bas phyi sgrub go chod byed na/ gzhal yas khang dbus gnam lcags kyi// 'khor lo rtsibs bcur pad+ma dang*/ sogs sbrel/ g.yon pas dung dmar gtso la stob// phyogs bzhir rigs bzhi rtsibs bcu la// steng phyogs hūm̐ dkar yab yum sngo// shar phyogs rnam rgyal yab yum dkar// shar lho dbyug sngon yab yum sngo// lho phyogs gshin rje yab yum sngo// lho nub mi g.yo yab yum ljang*// nub phyogs rta mgrin yab yum dmar// nub byang 'dod rgyal yab yum dmar// byang phyogs 'khyil pa yab yum ljang*// byang shar gsum rgyal yab yum ser// 'og tu stobs chen yab yum sngo/

de ltar khro bo nyer bzhi rnams/ sogs sbrel bas 'thus/ ༈ bsnyen mtshams la/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa 450) bsdu ldang bcas/ dkar gtor/ bgegs gtor/ bgegs bskrad/ rgyal tho 'dzug srung 'khor man chad nas bstod pa yan/ phreng ba byin rlabs/ bsnyen dmigs nang sgrub ltar/ sku phyag rgya/ gsung yig 'bru/ thugs chos nyid/ phyi sgrub ltar ye shes nye bsnyen gyi bsnyen pa'i yan lag nye bar bsnyen pa'i yan lag sgrub pa'i yan lag mgar gyi tshwa tshwa lta bu'i bzlas dmigs/ sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag ki la ya ltar shes pa/ chos nyid du shes pa/ tshe sgrub/ 'gugs gzhug tu shes pa/ dam can nye bar bsnyen pa/ ngan sngags nye bar bsnyen pa/ nang sgrub kyi sgrub pa'i dmigs pa/ yon tan dngos grub blang ba'i dmigs pa/ gsang sgrub bsnyen pa'i dmigs pa/ sgrub pa las sbyor 'gal me'i 'khor lo ltar bya ba/ yab yum zhal sbyor 'gal me'i 'khor lo ltar bya ba rnams dmigs pa thams cad res mos bsam nas/ bsnyen pa spu gri'i drag sngags brgyad cu rtsa bzhi pa 'di btang na bsnyen sgrub las gsum gcig chod du bsngags pa yin pas/ 'di kho na 'bum phrag bzlas pas mchog tu gyur ba yin no/ bzlas pa'i stong tshig dus bzang 451) rnams la tshogs skong dang*/ thun mtha' thams cad la bsdu ldang bsngo smon bkra shis rnams bya/ thun mtshams su nyal ba'i rnal 'byor/ ldang ba'i rnal 'byor/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor/ chos spyod kyi rnal 'byor/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor/ snang ba sku yi khyer so/ grags pa gsung gi khyer pas/ dran rtog thugs kyi khyer so/ khyad par gnad kyi zhal shes rnams la bslab pa gces so/ grol dus las byang bstod pa'i mthar tshogs skong tshar nas bsnyen dmigs nang sgrub ltar yon tan dngos grub blang ba'i dmigs pa sbrel te/ spu gri la/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ kā ya sid+dhi= sbrel ma bzla/ hūm̐: rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin rnams:

sogs kyis dngos grub blang*/ srung ma'i gtor chog lhag ma sogs nas mtha' bsdu'o/ sbyin sreg btang na yum ka'i sbyin sreg la 'di ga'i lha sngags sbyar nas/ spu gri'i sngags stong phrag bzlas pas 'grub bo/ 'di rnams brgyud ldan bla ma'i lung*// shugs las 'phros pa rang 'dod du// gang ltar byas kyang chog pa ru// dbang bskur thob par nongs med snyam// de phyir 452)bshad sgrub rgya mtsho yi// thugs dam nyams bzhes bya ba'i slad// dpal chen 'dus pa ming snyan po'i// cod pan 'chang des g.yar khral bris/ dge'o// lung rgyun ni/ dpal chen 'dus pa/ khang sprul bshad sgrub rgya mtsho/ bla ma 'jam dpal bzang pos bdag tshul khrims dpal bzang la nos pa dge'o// 453)༄༅/ rtsa gsum 'bras bu'i don khrid kyi/ pha dang 'dra ba'i bla sgrub ni/ rang nyid rta phag gsal byas nas: snying gar o rgyan yab yum ni: rdo rje 'chang du gsal bar byed: snying gi pad+ma phyi nang las: nang gi lnga la sku lnga bskyed: phyi yi brgyad la mtshan brgyad bskyed: mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can rnams: bdag la 'ja' ltar gsal bar bsam: thugs ka'i 'od zer 'phro 'du las: rgyal ba spyan drangs dbang thob bsam: sngags ni thod phreng hrīḥm sbrel/ ༈ bu dad 'dra ba'i yi dam ni/ rang nyid spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug: dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa: thal sbyar phreng ba pad+ma 'dzin: skyil krung nyi zla pad+mar bzhugs: thugs kar hrīḥl sngags kyis bskor: 'od 'phros ye shes sems dpa' drangs: dbang bzhi thob cing snang grags kun: ye shes chen po'i rol bar 'gyur: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ 454) ma dang 'dra ba'i ḍā ki ni/ rang nyid rdo rje phag mo dmar: spyan gsum spyi gtsug phag zhal mthing: rus rgyan gar stabs me klong 'gying: gnas bzhi mkha' 'gro sde bzhir bskyed: ma ha ri ni sa: ༈ 'jigs byed me yi spu gri/ stong pa'i ngang las gru gsum dmar nag klong:

glang thod zung bzhi nyi zla pad+ma'i steng sku mthing 'od zer 'phro 'dus yongs gyur lasaḥ bdag nyid ya man+ta ka mthing nag 'bar: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi 'dor thabs bsgrad: zhal dbus ma he'i gdang can rab du khros: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar spyan dgu gyen 'thur bsgrad: g.yas gsum gri gug ral gri gse thod 'bar: g.yon gsum thod khrag be con s+t+wa mo 'dzin: gshog pa zhing glang stag sbrul thod rlon phreng: tshangs skud rus rgyan dbus zhal steng 'jam dbyangs: 455)yum chen sor nag gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud: thugs kar hūm̐ mthing sngags kyi bskor bar bskyed: 'od 'phros rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i byin rlabs bcud: bsdus de bdag la thim pas dngos grub thob: oṃ ka la ru pa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ hriṣ+ṭi bi kri ta na na hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ shrī a kro te ka ya man+ta ka ya ma ra tsa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ klong gsal snying thig rta dmar ni/ bdag nyid dbang chen yab yum dmar: phyag mtshan gri thod rus rgyan dang: 'jigs byed phra man brgyad kyis bskor: thugs srog hriḥmathar sngags phreng las: 'od 'phros don gnyis lhun grub kyi: oṃ hriḥbadz+ra kro dha h+ya gri ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭaḥ hri ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsit+ta hring hring dzaḥdzaḥ rta nag ni/ stong pa'i ngang las gzhal yas khang gi dbusaḥ klu bdud bsnol ma 456)nyi zla pad+ma'i steng: hrīḥmathing 'od zer 'phro 'dus yongs gyur las: ma ha kro dha h+ya gri wa hūm̐: rta mgrin nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: g.yas pas ral gri g.yon pas lcags kyu zhags: spyan gsum sdang mig zhal gnyis 'dor thabs bsgrad: zhing glang stag lpags thod sbrul ser nag gsol: skra gseb khro chung mang pos gnod byed brlag: phyogs bzhir rigs bzhi dbu gtsug rta skad 'tsher: thugs kar nyi steng hrīḥlas sngags kyis bskoraḥ oṃ hrīḥbadz+ra kro dha h+ya gri ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: na ga rak+sha nag po ti pa ra tsa ma ra ya phaṭa:

༈ rdo rja gtum po zhi ba ni/ rang nyid gsang ba'i bdag po ljang*/ khro 'dzum rdo rje dril bu 'dzin// skyil krung stag sham rin chen rgyan// dar gyi cod paṇa sku rgyab phyang*// phyogs bzhi dpral bar khyung rigs lnga/ 457)khro bcu sgo bzhi mos pas bskyed// thugs kar hūm̐ mthar sngags kyis bskor/ oṃ badz+ra pa ṇi ni lam bha ra dha ra hūm̐ phaṭa: khro bo ni/ bdag nyid gsang bdag zhal gsum dkar dmar mthing*// phyag drug rdo rje ral gri 'khor lo g.yas// sdigs mdzub me 'bar dril bu sbrul zhags g.yon// zhabs bzhi 'dor stabs dbu steng rta gdong mtsher// sku yi bya khyung dkar po klad na lding*// sbrul stag glang zhing rgyan spras me klong bzhugs// rtsibs bzhir khyung bzhi rtsibs bcur khro bo bcu// rdo rje'i brag steng sgo skyong gdong mo bzhi// me tog phreng bar khro bcu grangs med gtams// thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ mthing sngags kyi bskor/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma ha ro kha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ

phur pa yang gsang spu gri ni/ hūm̐: rdo rje khros pas zhe sdang gcod: mtshon chen sngon po 458) 'bar ba yi: nam mkha'i dkyil nas thig pa shar: srog gi go ru shar ba dang: snying gi go ru bsgom par bya: bdag nyid ma bcos rdzogs pa'i sku: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu che: mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: zhabs bzhi gyad kyi 'dor thabs bsgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing nag: rigs lngas dbu rgyan thugs srog hūm̐: spyan dgu sdang mig phyogs bcur g.yo: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs: g.yas gnyis rtse dgu rtse lnga ste: g.yon gnyis me dpung kha ṭ+waṃ 'dzin: tha gnyis ri rab phur bu 'dril: dud khrod rab 'jigs chas rnams rdzogs: yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma: mthing skya zhal gcig phyag gnyis te: g.yas pas ut+pal mgul nas 'khyud: g.yon pas 459)dung dmar gtso la stob: phyogs bzhir rigs bzhi rtsibs bcu la: khro bcu yab yum za gsod bcas: sgo bzhir sgo ma gdong can bzhi: 'khor yug bka' sdod srung ma bcas: gtso 'khor yongs su rdzogs par bskyed: hūm̐: rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin rnams: srid pa rdo rje 'grub par mdzod: srid pa rdo rje phur pa'i lha: ye shes khro bo 'grub par mdzod: thugs kar ye shes ting 'dzin sems// sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar bsam/ oṃ badz+ra ki li ki la ya sarba big+nan bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: mtsho rgyal ma ni/ bdag nyid mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal ma: dkar mo mdangs can bcu drug na tshod mdzes: bod mo'i cha byad yid 'ong blta na sdug: phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag thod dkar rin chen 'bar: dpral bar sin+dhu ra yi thig les mtshan: gnas gsum 460)'bru gsum 'od kyis 'khor 'das kyi: dngas bcud bsdus nas bdag la thim pa las: rtsa gnas mkha' 'gros sngags sgra sgrog par bsam: oṃ dzñā na bud+dha dhā ki ni sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: sgrol ma ni/ stong pa'i ngang las g.yu lo bkod pa'i// zhing khams dbus su pad zla'i gdan la// tāṃ yig ljang gu'i 'od kyi 'phro 'du// yongs su gyur las 'phags ma sgrol ma// sku mdog ljang gu phyag g.yas mchog sbyin// g.yon pas ut+pal yu ba bzung ba'i// 'dab ma snyan gyi thad dkar rgyas ma// g.yas bskyang g.yon bskum sems ma'i dor stabs// dbu gtsug 'od dpag med pas brgyan cing*// dar dang rin chen rgyan gyi klubs ma// mtha' skor sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig

/sangs rgyas byang sems tshogs kyi bskor ma// gnas gsum 'bru gsum thugs kar tām̐ ljang*/ 461)/lte ba'i hrīḥser rnams las 'od 'phros// ye shes spyan drangs rang la thim pas// rje btsun 'phags mas byin gyis rlobs mdzod/ oṃ ta re tut+ta re tu re swa hāḥ zhes pa'ang o rgyan tshe ring gi bzhed ngor dpal chen 'dus pas bris pa dge legs 'phel/ dge'o// 462)
